name: Socrates
description: An AI tutor for people who want to understand — built around Socratic dialogue, durable recall, and a knowledge map.

tools.name: socrates.bootstrap
tools.description: Return the mobile-shell bootstrap contract (product, platform, webBaseUrl, apiBaseUrl, healthPath).

tools.name: socrates.health
tools.description: Liveness probe. Returns 200 when the API and database are reachable.

tools.name: socrates.config
tools.description: Front-end capability config (whether the built-in provider is configured and reasoning-capable).

tools.name: socrates.openapi_url
tools.description: Pointer to the Socrates OpenAPI 3.0 specification.

tools.name: socrates.research_index
tools.description: Index of the six published research notes with slug, title, date, and URL.

tools.name: socrates.docs
tools.description: Catalogue of long-form documentation pages with optional kind filter.

tools.name: socrates.skill
tools.description: Render an MCP App that explains a Socrates tutor skill (Socratic dialogue, recall queue, knowledge map, exam mode, mistake book) and lets the user open a relevant session.

resources.name: Bootstrap contract viewer
resources.description: Renders the mobile-shell bootstrap contract with copy-to-clipboard for every field.

resources.name: Research index browser
resources.description: Sortable / filterable view of the six published research notes.

resources.name: Documentation browser
resources.description: Filterable index of the long-form documentation pages.

resources.name: Skill explorer
resources.description: Interactive panel that previews a Socrates tutor skill and deep-links to a relevant session in the web app.

skills.name: Recall queue
skills.description: Spaced-repetition prompts that surface saved moments at the right interval.

skills.name: Knowledge map
skills.description: Relationships between ideas, maintained across sessions.

skills.name: Exam mode
skills.description: Retrieval-practice mode that surfaces questions at the end of a study block.

skills.name: Mistake book
skills.description: Collect moments where the learner's explanation showed a seam.
